name: 儿童圆领套头卫衣多彩款
description: 儿童圆领套头卫衣套图：白底主图、多色选码、印花与面料细节、穿搭场景全链路

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots and spec screens, blush pink #F9E8E6 for benefit and closing shots, warm off-white and pale pink for flat-lay and lifestyle
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, gentle front or front-left key, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte seamless studio backdrop and soft folded knit fabric as the tactile surface
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single charcoal color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the garment across the set, flat-lay shots stay symmetrical
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft playful childrenswear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, blush pink #F9E8E6, heather grey #D9DADC and charcoal text #3A3A3C; bright soft studio lighting with a gentle front key and soft contact shadows; modern rounded sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end childrenswear photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底主图
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, garment laid flat and centered, full silhouette visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, gentle front key with soft fill
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The sweatshirt laid flat and centered, straight-on eye-level view, full garment visible with the sleeves arranged neatly to the sides. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a gentle front key and soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the garment. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The garment occupies 60-70% of the frame with no extra whitespace reserved for copy. Clean commercial childrenswear e-commerce quality. Negative: no child model, no hangers, no watermark, no fake logo, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics, no printed graphics or lettering on the fabric, no cut-off sleeves, no colored background tint.

shots.intent: 一秒传达多彩百搭的核心卖点，承接主图流量
shots.camera: slight 3/4 eye-level, three stacked garments arranged front-center
shots.lighting: soft front-left key light, soft contact shadow
shots.textZone: top headline band with three small tag chips
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Three stacked sweatshirts arranged front-center at a slight 3/4 eye-level view, the front garment fully visible. Soft front-left key light with a soft contact shadow. Blush pink background #F9E8E6. A headline band reading 「{selling_point_1}」 sits at the top with three small tag chips 「{selling_point_2}」 「{selling_point_3}」 「{selling_point_4}」 under it, leaving clean margin around the text. The garment group occupies 50-60% of the frame. Negative: no more than one headline claim, no invented fabric percentages or efficacy claims, no watermark, no fake logo, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics, no props covering the garments.

shots.intent: 一屏看全全部配色，降低选色流失

shots.lighting: bright even high-key lighting, identical across all garments

provenance.notes: 逐屏：1主视觉三件麻灰卫衣叠放加标题与三枚标签位；2五色折叠成排、印花工艺特写、罗纹圆领特写；3-4产品信息与尺码表（身高80-150cm分段、衣长胸围肩宽袖长实测值、面料成分比例、A类等级、厚度版型柔软指数条）；4-5粉色针织面料褶皱特写与五枚特性图标行（含抗菌等功效断言）；5-6灰色大面料纹理、平铺展示标题、四块灰色色块位与系列英文字样；7-9优质面料、包边、做工、腰部细节文案条；9-11婴儿模特坐姿与黄色圆球道具，模特所穿为浅蓝背带裤与主商品卫衣不一致，且带可辨识童颜。品类判定：尺码表按建议身高80-150cm分段、品名为卡通卫衣、圆领套头外穿形态，判为母婴/童装而非儿童内衣（贴身睡衣家居）。已剥离：品牌栏、A类等级、面料成分比例、尺码表实测值、抗菌等功效与安全断言、面料产地宣称、系列英文字样、童模面容（改背影颈部以下裁切）、尾屏异款服装形态（一律以 {product} 占位），原文案与色块图文改占位符或空白 proof 位。
